notes: This contract governs formal prepared temporal evidence only; it does not award Visual Fidelity points.

Unity 6 exposes QualitySettings.enableLODCrossFade as the global LOD cross-fade enable and QualitySettings.lodBias/maximumLODLevel as global LOD selection controls. Formal temporal evidence must not be captured with cross-fade disabled, LOD0 globally skipped, or lodBias below the authored baseline.

LODGroup.crossFadeAnimationDuration is global for animated LOD cross-fading and must be positive. The contract intentionally does not claim that any particular positive duration is visually sufficient; actual temporal pixels remain authoritative.

The runtime fingerprint binds the current quality-level identity, global LOD controls, global cross-fade duration, DanchiHighDetail LODGroup topology, transition heights, renderer assignments, reference point/size, and root world transform before every guarded MainCamera cull.
The existing detail LOD physical-UV QA remains responsible for mesh/material/physical-UV continuity across LOD0/1/2/3; this contract closes the separate global/runtime selection-state gap.

A stable runtime fingerprint is evidence provenance, not proof that LOD transitions are invisible. Native 3840x2160 temporal sequences and 100% pixel review are still mandatory before scoring Temporal/LOD/aliasing stability.
